## About
Raven's Manor is a haunted manor themed cocktail bar on SW 1st Ave in Portland. The room is dressed to feel like an old haunted mansion, and the drinks lean into the theme, each with its own spooky twist.
The cocktails are the main event, but the kitchen keeps a short menu of hearty, freshly prepared meals. One guest told us not to skip the artichoke dip.
For something more hands-on, Dr. Raven's Elixir Experience takes groups through a guided potion-making session where you craft your own drinks. Guests have rated us 4.6 from 1670 Google reviews.

## Services
- Signature cocktails: Creative cocktails, each with a fun, spooky-themed twist, served in the haunted manor setting.
- The Elixir Experience: A guided potion-making session with actors in character, where you craft your own cocktails. It is an add-on with an upcharge, and there is an observation window so you can watch a session in progress.
- Dining menu: A limited dining menu where everything is freshly prepared.

## FAQ
Q: Should I make a reservation?
A: One reviewer recommends booking well in advance, as the place is very popular.

Q: Can I do the Elixir Experience without alcohol?
A: One guest said they were able to make zero-proof mocktails for their drinks during the experience.

Q: Are you open on Tuesday?
A: No, we are closed on Tuesday. We open in the evening every other day of the week.

## What customers say
- "The overall atmosphere at Raven's Manor is absolutely great. We actually stop by whenever we come down to Portland, but our visit on Saturday, May 23rd for the 9:00 PM show was our very first time doing the Elixir Experience, and it was such a memorable time. Everyone there is always so welcoming!

While the venue itself is incredible, the actors are what truly elevate the lab to a top-tier night out. Mordred and Mum were our main hosts, and they completely stole the show. Mum’s performance was genuinely fantastic—she stayed perfectly in character and added so much depth to the dark, haunted aesthetic. Mordred was overall amazing; he struck the perfect balance between keeping up an incredible theatrical performance and being genuinely helpful as he guided us through crafting our drinks. Lilith was also fantastic—while she was focused on guiding other groups through their potions, her energy and dedication to her character kept the entire room perfectly immersed.

The mixology aspect is a blast, and the drinks themselves were amazing. Our personal favorite was the Quantum Leap, but honestly, every single potion we had was phenomenal.

We’ll definitely be coming back this Halloween for a haunting time to celebrate a birthday. Highly recommend!" (Alex Barron, 5/5)
- "Raven's Manor is hands down the best thing we did on our trip to Oregon in July of this year. Despite only having been open for five years, the space is beautifully decorated to look like a withering, centuries-old haunted mansion. Your jaw drops the second you walk inside, and the staff go above and beyond to be sure that the reality of your table experience meets the expectation set by your first impressions of the bar. The dining menu is limited, but everything on it is freshly prepared and absolutely delicious. The drinks, which are more the focus of the establishment anyway - are also spectacular and each come with a fun, spooky-themed twist. We would definitely recommend making a reservation well in advance, as this place is very popular and gets booked solid very quickly. Although we weren't able to secure a booking for the Elixir Experience (upcharge), I think we can safely recommend that as a fun little add-on, as well; there's an observation window where you can see the experience in progress, and it looks like an absolute blast! We genuinely can't recommend the establishment enough, and will definitely be returning to the Manor on our next Portland trip." (Timandkt, 5/5)
- "Couldn't have had a better experience for our anniversary or any other night.  Megan and Amelia were both so lovely, the atmosphere and decor is all around amazing and the food is truly incredible. I haven't had a meal as perfectly seasoned as this in forever. For people that cook good food looking for a place that doesn't disappoint, this is THE PLACE. Every dish and drink was perfectly executed. We will definitely become regulars after tonight.
Sidenote: if you're doubting the artichoke dip, DO NOT. Its so good I had to cut myself off or I wouldn't have had room for my meal." (Lexi (Lexi), 5/5)
- "It’s been a long, long time since my wife and I visited but now feels like as good a time as any. Regardless, being from Mississippi turned this into an extremely unique experience…It very refreshing to be around some like-minded individuals. We participated in a unique role play where we were grouped and taken down to the basement for a potion-making class (potions being cocktails, of course) and we got a chance to learn a bit and get drunk. All around an excellent experience and we can’t wait for our next chance to visit the Manor and partake of its spoils." (Gregory King, 5/5)
- "We went through the Dr. Raven’s Elixir Experience and had a wonderful time! Our hosts were wonderful actors who stayed in character the whole time, and the escape room portion was fun and deeply cooperative. The drinks we made were delicious, and I appreciated that I could make zero-proof mocktails for my drinks. I highly recommend this fun and funny experience." (Sheena McFarland, 5/5)
